reason: I already reorder Toplux when it runs out and my drawer is full of half-used bottles, so I don't need another one. $29.99 is more than what I pay now for a bottle that lasts longer.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I'd be paying extra for sachets when I already have a routine that works.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what I pay now, around $19 to $22 a box, or a free trial box so I can see if it's any different from what I already take.
